atoms.definition: Operates on the rising edge of clk; rst_n is asynchronous and active-low. Reset immediately sets desc_ready=1 and cancels unfinished operations. desc_result has no reset guarantee; interpret the result only after a complete operation finishes following the current reset and during the subsequent idle period; do not check the result between starting a new operation and completion. Inputs are definite 0/1 values, established before the edge; separate the reset response between edges from stable observations after the edge.
atoms.title: Reset and valid domain

atoms.definition: In the idle state with desc_ready=1, assert only one of des_encipher_en or des_decipher_en for one sampling edge, called cycle 1; afterward, both remain 0 until completion. Hold data and key from before the request until completion. On cycle 1 following the request, ready becomes 0; on cycle 18 for encryption or cycle 33 for decryption, ready returns to 1 and the final result is provided simultaneously. In idle, ready remains 1. Simultaneous requests, requests while busy, or holding a request for multiple cycles are prohibited and are outside the legal domain.
atoms.title: Request and completion timing

atoms.definition: des_data and des_key_in are both 64 bits, with the most significant bit corresponding to standard DES bit 1. Encryption uses standard DES (FIPS 46-3), with a 64-bit initial permutation, 16 Feistel rounds, and inverse permutation; key PC1 removes the parity bit of each byte, and circular left shifts by 1,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,1,2,2,2,2,2,2,1 generate 16 PC2 subkeys. The input to the final inverse permutation is R16 concatenated with L16. The standard vector 0123456789ABCDEF with key 133457799BBCDFF1 produces 85E813540F0AB405.
atoms.title: DES encryption

atoms.definition: Decryption uses the same DES data transformation but uses the 16 subkeys in reverse order; the standard ciphertext 85E813540F0AB405 decrypts to 0123456789ABCDEF using 133457799BBCDFF1. The least significant bit of each byte is a key parity bit and does not contribute to the result; changing these bits does not change the result for the same direction; no parity checking or error reporting is performed.
atoms.title: DES decryption and key parity bits

atoms.definition: After completion, if no new operation is started and no reset occurs, desc_result retains the final value; changing input data or the key while idle does not update this result. Each new legal request uses the data and key for that request; the direction, data, and key of previous transactions do not contaminate subsequent results.
